framework: ve(3,3) vote-escrow + multisig (Velodrome V2 fork, OZ Governor-based SimpleEpochGovernor)
votingUnit: veAERO (AERO locked in VotingEscrow NFTs, up to 4 years)
proposalRequirements: Protocol parameter changes: 3/7 Aerodrome Governor multisig. Emission direction: any veAERO holder votes weekly via Voter. Tail-rate nudge: one on-chain proposal per epoch in SimpleEpochGovernor (OZ Governor fork) once tail emissions are active.
votingProcess: veAERO holders vote weekly per epoch on gauges/nudges; proposals created in epoch n execute in epoch n+1. Protocol changes via 3/7 multisig.
